reference.summary: A white pelican with an orange pouch pedals a red bicycle across grass, with clouds, a sun and speed lines; it is a clear, polished answer to the prompt.

defects.what: The body sits over the frame with no visible saddle, so the seating reads ambiguously
defects.where: the pelican's body over the top tube
defects.expected: The pelican clearly sits on a saddle attached to the seat post

defects.what: The wing reaches forward to the handlebar but its grip is vague and it blends into the bar
defects.where: the wing tip at the handlebar
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly holds the handlebar

defects.what: One leg crosses in front of the chainring and frame tubes, making the lines tangled
defects.expected: The legs and drivetrain are clearly layered so each part reads on its own

defects.what: The beak and pouch overlap a cloud, so the head merges with the background
defects.where: upper middle, at the pelican's head
defects.expected: The head stands out clearly against open sky

attempt.summary: A white pelican with a big orange pouch rides a red bicycle on a green hill under a sun; the scene answers the prompt clearly, but the rider's connection to the bike is loose.

defects.what: The pelican's body floats above the frame with no seat or saddle under it, so it is unclear what it is sitting on
defects.where: the pelican's body over the top tube
defects.expected: The pelican visibly sits on a saddle attached to the seat post

defects.what: One leg ends in mid-air beside the crank instead of resting on a pedal, and the feet are just thin line ends
defects.where: the pelican's legs and the pedals
defects.expected: Both feet are on the pedals, with recognisable webbed feet

defects.what: The wing tip stretches out to the handlebar like an arm, but it does not clearly grip it
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly rests on or holds the handlebar

defects.what: The wheels have only a few uneven spokes, so they look unfinished
defects.expected: Evenly spaced spokes, or a deliberately simplified wheel style

defects.what: The beak reaches almost to the sun and crowds the upper right
defects.where: upper right, between the beak and the sun
defects.expected: More breathing room between the bird's head and the sun
